lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg8Al4Pt4 (Mg2AlPt) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mg, 6 Pt) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg and Pt centers each have 16 neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg and Pt coordination polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Al and Mg polyhedra.
